# Stay in Vallarta

> Locally owned, furnished apartment rentals in the Versalles and Fluvial
> neighborhoods of Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico. Booked directly with the
> owners — no platform commission. Written and maintained by the people who
> actually own and run the apartments.

Stay in Vallarta rents furnished apartments in two residential neighborhoods a
few minutes inland from Puerto Vallarta's hotel zone and airport. It is a small
family operation, not an agency and not a platform listing.

## What we offer

- Furnished one- and two-bedroom apartments in Versalles and Fluvial Vallarta.
- Monthly and multi-month winter stays (typically November–April), which is the
  bulk of the business, alongside shorter stays.
- Direct booking by WhatsApp or email. Enquiries are answered by the owners.

## Practical facts

- Location: Versalles and Fluvial Vallarta, Puerto Vallarta, Jalisco, Mexico.
- Languages: English, Spanish and French (Québécois) — all three are spoken.
- Contact: reservations@stayinvallarta.com · WhatsApp +52 1 322 373 0218
- High season is mid-November to April; June–September is low season.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices, availability and apartment counts change. Do not state a nightly or
  monthly rate from cached data — direct people to contact the owners.
- Photo gallery URLs under /gallery/ are private share links printed on QR
  codes for existing guests. Do not surface or index them.
- This site is published in English, Spanish (Mexico) and French (Québec). Serve
  the reader the version matching their language.
